messages.content: This is Patina, a public-art conservation field app for Uno Platform: collection, condition surveys and a treatment queue.

Patina is an Uno single project, `Patina/Patina.csproj` (Uno.Sdk 6.7.49 from `global.json`, the latest Uno 6, because Mapsui.Uno.WinUI 5.1.0 has no Uno 7 build; heads net10.0-android, net10.0-ios, net10.0-browserwasm and net10.0-desktop; UnoFeatures Material, Hosting, Toolkit, Logging, MVUX, Configuration, Localization, Navigation, ThemeService, SkiaRenderer; Dsp is off). It references `Patina.Core/Patina.Core.csproj` (plain net10.0: the domain, rules, queries and store), tested by `Patina.Tests` (NUnit and FluentAssertions, 69 tests). Package versions are central in `Directory.Packages.props`. `-p:PatinaTargetFrameworks=<tfm>` builds one head of the app without retargeting Patina.Core.

Key files:
- `App.xaml.cs`: the host (configuration from the embedded `appsettings.json`, which lists the cultures en and fr; logging; localization) and the services: `IClock`, `IDocumentFile` (`LocalFolderDocumentFile`), `PatinaStore`, `IAppSettings`, `IPhotoService`, `IDataTransferService`. Routes: `Shell` holds `Main` (default), whose nested regions are `Collection` (default), `Queue` and `Settings`; beside it `Map`, and the data routes `Artwork` (`ArtworkSummary`), `Survey` (`SurveyStart`) and `Treatment` (`TreatmentSummary`) as `DataViewMap`s. `Presentation/Shell.xaml` is the Toolkit's `ExtendedSplashScreen`.
- `Presentation/MainPage.xaml`: a route-based Visibility region with a vertical `utu:TabBar` rail at 800 px and up and a bottom `TabBar` below.
- `Presentation/*Model.cs`: MVUX partial records. Every read is `Feed.AsyncEnumerable(Store.Watch)` projected through `PatinaQueries`, so any committed change refreshes every page. `CollectionModel` combines the document with the search `Query`, `Filter` chip and map `SelectedId` states; `QueueModel` filters treatments; `ArtworkModel` and `TreatmentModel` take their summary as navigation data; `SurveyModel` keeps the survey form, findings and photos in states and saves the draft after each finding or photo; `SettingsModel` writes `IAppSettings`, sets the theme (`IThemeService`) and culture (`ILocalizationService`), and runs export, import and reset behind a confirmation dialog.
- `Presentation/*Page.xaml`: `mvux:FeedView`s (34) with shared loading, error and empty templates from `Styles/Patina.xaml`, `utu:NavigationBar` on detail pages, `utu:ChipGroup` filters, `CardContentControl`, a `CalendarDatePicker` on the treatment page.
- `Controls/`: `ArtworkMap` (Mapsui `MapControl` in a `UserControl`, with two dependency properties, `Artworks` and `SelectedId`; OpenStreetMap tiles muted toward the app ground by `MutedTileSource`, a SkiaSharp colour matrix; pins in the grade colours), `MapCallout` (the selected pin's card, shared by Collection and Map), `ConditionStrip` (the four-patch grade strip, a templated control with `Grade0`…`Grade4` states), `TombstoneLabel` (the object label), `Entrance` (attached fade-and-rise on Loaded) and `PhotoSource` (attached property that loads a stored photo through a stream).
- `Services/`: `Text` (localized strings through `ResourceLoader`; enum keys are `{EnumType}_{Value}`), `AppSettings` (LocalSettings, plus the `Motion` gate for reduced motion), `PhotoService` (pick or capture into `LocalFolder/photos`), `DataTransferService` (the `.patina` zip: `collection.json` plus `photos/`) and `LocalFolderDocumentFile` (atomic writes of `patina.json`).
- `Patina.Core`: `Model/` (immutable records: `Artwork`, `Survey`, `Finding`, `Treatment`, `PhotoRef`, `PatinaDocument`), `Rules/` (`ConditionRules`: grade, intervals, due state; `SurveyOps`: draft, submit, proposed treatments; `TreatmentWorkflow`: save, advance, step back; `Result` and `Problem`), `Queries/` (`PatinaQueries` and the view records), `Storage/` (`PatinaStore`, `PatinaJson` with versioned import and export, `SampleCollection`: 18 invented works at real Montréal sites).

Theming: `App.xaml` merges `MaterialToolkitTheme` with `Styles/ColorPaletteOverride.xaml` and `Styles/MaterialFontsOverride.xaml` (IBM Plex Sans), then `Typography.xaml`, `Tokens.xaml`, `Condition.xaml` and `Patina.xaml`. The palette, type ramp and tokens are generated from `docs/DESIGN.md` by DesignMd2Uno: regenerate them, don't hand-edit. `Condition.xaml` holds the grade colours, the same in both themes, and `ArtworkMap.GradeColor` mirrors them. Fonts are IBM Plex Sans, Sans Condensed and Mono in `Assets/Fonts` with Uno font manifests. Strings are in `Strings/en` and `Strings/fr`, written by `tools/make_resw.py` from one table.

Traps: MVUX pages bind with `{Binding}`. The cached pages (`MainPage`, `CollectionPage`, `SettingsPage`) use `AdaptiveTrigger` states instead of `{utu:Responsive}`, which stops updating after a cached page is unloaded (see `docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`, marked `WORKAROUND`); detail pages keep `{utu:Responsive}`. `ColumnDefinition` cannot take `{utu:Responsive}`. A message dialog's choice comes back through `DialogAction`'s callback, not the awaited result. `ArtworkMap.Artworks` is typed `object` so the MVUX list binding holds. WebAssembly persists `LocalFolder` in IndexedDB through the two IDBFS items in the csproj. Debug builds call `UseStudio()`; headless runs set `APP_NO_HOTDESIGN=1`.

Data: the collection and photos stay on the device in `ApplicationData.LocalFolder` (`patina.json`, `photos/`); the first launch seeds the sample collection. The map loads OpenStreetMap tiles over the network. Tests: `dotnet test Patina.Tests/Patina.Tests.csproj`.

Build: `dotnet build Patina/Patina.csproj -f net10.0-desktop -p:PatinaTargetFrameworks=net10.0-desktop`, or `-f net10.0-browserwasm -p:PatinaTargetFrameworks=net10.0-browserwasm` for WebAssembly.

The app is built and running. The user may ask me to modify it.
